en: a father wearing a kippah looking at a boy wearing a kippah while holding up a photo of a different boy, two figures only, no text (expects him to be someone else)

en: a boy wearing a kippah smiling over an open book with blank pages and reaching for another book from the shelf, only the one boy in this panel, no letters, no text (be happy and want more)

en: a boy wearing a kippah leaning back with a full tummy look and closing a book, only the one boy in this panel, no letters, no text (be full and stop)
